results.title: Coordinator creates a booking: 1 unit, 2 days, 10% discount
Quote → Booked writes exactly one reservation (R-26)
A conflicting booking — same unit, overlapping dates — is REFUSED
A same-day turnaround is ACCEPTED (half-open bounds)
A quantity line beyond stock on hand is REFUSED by the capacity ceiling (0045)
Booked → Packed → On Rent as Warehouse requires the session rows each stage needs
A partial return: one unit back, one missing
Accounts raises and issues the invoice: figures snapshot and become immutable (R-15, Law 4)
Four payments that must all be refused
Two payments settle the invoice: 3,000 then 4,119
Closed needs a settled invoice
Money-blind roles read no money and write none
Even the Owner cannot rewrite the audit log or delete a payment
Client portal user sees only their own rows, never another client's
Unit status is owned by the engine; direct write is refused (S1-5)
Invoice void discipline: role check, reason, credit note requirement (S1-3)
Server-side prices for money-blind callers, line guard, role ceiling & user immutability (S1-6, S1-7)
Booking schedule changes cannot desynchronise reservations
A payment reversal cannot exceed the receipt across partial corrections
Bulk stock adjustment is atomic, idempotent, reasoned, and Manager-only
A consumable line deducts stock at Handover and needs no return receipt (0141/0142)
Smart Intel note visibility and classified values are filtered by RLS for every role
extend_booking RPC extends return dates, increments line days, and updates reservations (AUD D5)
void_invoice RPC atomically issues credit note for paid amounts and voids invoice (AUD D6)
Client Save changes is one atomic, idempotent, revision-locked write; contact removal keeps history (0146)
Equipment Save changes edits catalogue, rates and unit location only; stock, custody and identity are refused (0146)
Bundle Save changes preserves component identity and soft-deactivates removed components (0146)
Quote Save changes is atomic, revision-locked, quote-only and invoice-safe; it makes no reservations (0147)
update_bundle applies patch, line edits, adds and soft-deactivations in ONE transaction (0153)
Close skips a held deposit only with a reason from Manager+, audited, moving no money (0155)
Pre-handover reversal and terminal archive are audited, idempotent and Manager-only (0167)
